name: 戴源昌
objective:
本課程為整合家具與室內設計之進階課程。藉由相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，以創意激發的訓練為主，透過實際設計程序的演練，習得設計的方法並培養解決問題的能力。
This course is an advanced program that integrates furniture design and interior design. Through related design competitions or industry-academia cooperation projects, creativity is emphasized in the training, and students will learn design methods and cultivate problem-solving abilities by practicing actual design procedures.

2.	學習態度主要檢驗學生出勤狀況與是否積極參與指定競賽項目。

consultation: 學生可藉由 e-mail 或 Line 群組隨時聯繫!
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
